mapper.insert: INSERT INTO water_sources (str_id, user_id, source_name, source_type, dify_conversation_id, description, created_at, is_active) VALUES (#{strId}, #{userId}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceType}, #{difyConversationId}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{isActive})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM water_sources WHERE str_id = #{strId} AND user_id = #{userId}
